passage.text: Is your bag lost or damaged?
passage.reading: ɪz jʊr ˈbæɡ ˈlɔːst ɔːr ˈdæmɪdʒd?

passage.text: Go to the baggage desk next to baggage claim and report the problem.
passage.reading: ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈbæɡɪdʒ ˌdɛsk ˈnɛkst tə ˈbæɡɪdʒ ˌkleɪm ənd rɪˈpɔːrt ðə ˈprɑːbləm.

passage.text: Please bring your passport, your boarding pass and your luggage tag.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ jʊr ˈpæspɔːrt, jʊr ˈbɔːrdɪŋ ˌpæs ənd jʊr ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ˌtæɡ.

passage.text: Tell us the size and color of your bag, and what was in it.
passage.reading: ˈtɛl ʌs ðə ˈsaɪz ənd ˈkʌlər əv jʊr ˈbæɡ, ənd ˈwʌt wʌz ɪn ɪt.

passage.text: We will give you a report number.
passage.reading: wiː wɪl ˈɡɪv juː ə rɪˈpɔːrt ˈnʌmbər.

passage.text: You must report a damaged bag within seven days.
passage.reading: juː mʌst rɪˈpɔːrt ə ˈdæmɪdʒd ˈbæɡ wɪˈðɪn ˈsɛvən ˈdeɪz.

passage.text: Most lost bags arrive within two days.
passage.reading: ˈmoʊst ˈlɔːst ˈbæɡz əˈraɪv wɪˈðɪn ˈtuː ˈdeɪz.

passage.text: When we find your bag, we will bring it to your home or hotel.
passage.reading: wɛn wiː ˈfaɪnd jʊr ˈbæɡ, wiː wɪl ˈbrɪŋ ɪt tə jʊr ˈhoʊm ɔːr hoʊˈtɛl.

passage.text: You don't have to pay for this service.
passage.reading: juː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ fər ðɪs ˈsɜːrvɪs.

passage.text: If you have any questions, please go to the baggage desk.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz, ˈpliːz ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈbæɡɪdʒ ˌdɛsk.
